subject: pkg/executor: fix the hang issue in indexHashJoin (#49218)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent (executor-only). It threads a worker-cancelable context (`ctxWithCancel`) through `IndexNestedLoopHashJoin` and records recovered panics (`panicErr`) so the main thread unblocks and returns the real panic error instead of hanging / returning `context canceled`; it also adds a failpoint+test for #49033. No remaining Blocker/High issues: the only High-risk ordered-mode edge (dry-up path could miss returning `panicErr`) was fixed later upstream in commit 70aad89294 (PR #49454), and upstream/master further hardens panicErr handling.
